title: feat(types): declare the spec's axis config object on ChartSchema.xAxis / yAxis (objectui#7690)
body:
Fixes #7690
Clause-②: yes

Ruling `5809510046` (letter measure-then-branch) lands on **branch 2 — declare**. The protocol answered first, and the liveness read agrees with it: `ChartSchema.xAxis` / `ChartSchema.yAxis` now declare `@objectstack/spec`'s axis config object **by reference**, on both faces. No renderer changed.

## 1. Protocol first — the spec DECLARES the object

Read in the installed dist that `pnpm-lock.yaml` pins (`@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0), at `node_modules/.pnpm/@objectstack+spec@17.4.0_ai@7.0.65_zod@4.4.3_/node_modules/@objectstack/spec/dist/ui/` (`index.d.ts` for the shapes, `index.mjs` for the runtime definition):

| spec symbol | what it says |
|---|---|
| `ChartAxisSchema` / `ChartAxis` | a `strictObject` (with an alias map: `grid` → `showGridLines`, `logScale` → `logarithmic`, `name`/`dataKey` → `field`, …) of nine keys: `field` (required string), `title` (`I18nLabel`), `format`, `min`, `max`, `stepSize`, `showGridLines` (`.default(true)`), `position` (`left`/`right`/`top`/`bottom`), `logarithmic` (`.default(false)`) |
| `ChartConfigSchema` | `xAxis: ChartAxisSchema.optional()`, `yAxis: z.array(ChartAxisSchema).optional()` — one object for x, a LIST for y |
| `DashboardWidgetSchema.chartConfig` | typed `ChartConfigSchema` — the surface `DatasetWidget` lowers onto this `chart` node |
| `ReportChartSchema.xAxis` / `.yAxis` | bare strings — the report surface, a different surface (its renderer never forwards them to a `chart` node) |

⇒ The spec declares the object and its nine keys. Per the dispatch, the mirror follows the spec's declared keys and a retire branch is closed (it would contradict a spec declaration). The liveness read below therefore decides nothing further; it is reported because the ruling asked for it and because it agrees.

## 2. What the renderer reads (re-measured — the card's list was five keys, the read is nine)

- `normalizeAxis` in `plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts` reads exactly the spec's nine: `field`, `format`, `min`, `max`, `stepSize` (kept only when greater than 0), `showGridLines`, `logarithmic`, `position`, `title` (through `pickLocalized`).
- The axes block of `normalizeChartSchema`: `xAxisKey` wins over `xAxis.field` (`str(schema.xAxisKey) ?? xAxisSpec?.field ?? str(xAxisRaw)`); `yAxis` is read as a list, and also TOLERATED as a single object or as bare strings.
- `AdvancedChartImpl` consumes the normalized axes: `numericAxisSpecProps` (`min`/`max` domain, `stepSize` ticks, `logarithmic` scale, `title` label), `formatterFor(format)`, `showGridLines` (horizontal grid off on an explicit `false` on the first y axis; vertical grid on an explicit `true` on x), `position === 'right'` for the secondary axis.
- `axisPresentation` in `@object-ui/core` (`chart-presentation.ts`) is the in-repo PRODUCER: `DatasetWidget` → `mergeAuthoredPresentation` writes `xAxis` (object) and `yAxis` (list) onto the `type: 'chart'` node from the widget's spec-declared `chartConfig`, carrying `title`/`format`/`min`/`max`/`stepSize`/`showGridLines`/`position`/`logarithmic` and dropping `field` as data.

## 3. Per-key liveness read, with lit controls

Instrument: a scanner that finds every `xAxis` / `yAxis` key whose value opens an object or a list, extracts the balanced literal and lists the keys at axis-object level; the control on the same file population is the count of `xAxisKey:` (a key that IS written).

| repo @ revision | files | axis-object hits | control `xAxisKey:` | where the hits are |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| objectui @ `80a0ecda9` | 8407 | 47 | 149 | tests only (`plugin-charts`, `plugin-dashboard`, `core`) plus one comment; authored surfaces all 0 with lit controls: `examples/` 0 (control 3), `content/` 0 (control 24), `apps/` 0 (control 2), `packages/types/examples` 0 (control 1); the `chart` registration's designer `inputs` carry no `xAxis`/`yAxis` (control: its `xAxisKey` input) |
| objectstack @ `8d76c2d38` (`origin/main` of the local clone) | 9296 | 39 | 2 | one producer: the showcase command-center page writes `yAxis: [{ field, stepSize }]` on an `object-chart`; the rest are lint/spec tests, a liveness ledger and a `docs/notes` analysis page |
| hotcrm @ `087b7c5` | 847 | 18 | 0 (the 18 hits light the instrument themselves) | every hit a dashboard widget `chartConfig` (activity, crm, sales, service): `xAxis { field, title, showGridLines, logarithmic }` ×9, `yAxis [{ field, title, format?, showGridLines, logarithmic }]` ×9 — dataset-bound, so they reach this node through `DatasetWidget` |
| cloud | — | not reachable | — | `git ls-remote` asks for credentials |

| key | real producer |
|---|---|
| `field` | hotcrm dashboards ×18; showcase `object-chart` ×1 |
| `title`, `showGridLines`, `logarithmic` | hotcrm dashboards ×18 each; `DatasetWidget` lowering |
| `format` | hotcrm `yAxis` ×4; `DatasetWidget` lowering |
| `stepSize` | showcase `object-chart` ×1; `DatasetWidget` lowering |
| `min`, `max`, `position` | `DatasetWidget` lowering (no authored document in the reachable repos writes them) |

Every key has a producer path, so branch 2 applies to all nine even before the spec declaration settles it.

The two `yAxis` shapes the normalizer tolerates but the spec does not declare: a **single object** is written only by the `docs/notes` analysis page in objectstack (a legacy, pre-dataset widget sketch, not a producer — the spec's own `chartConfig` would refuse it), and a **bare string** only by a normalizer unit test and by the report surface, which never reaches this node. Neither is declared (AGENTS.md #0.1; the reading objectui#7546 applied to `variant: 'current'`); the normalizer's tolerance is untouched.

## 4. The change

- `packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts` — `ChartSchema.xAxis` is `z.union([z.string(), stripImportedDefaults(SpecChartAxisSchema)])`: the bare-string arm is the objectui#7113 alias, still folded onto `xAxisKey` by `foldChartXAxisAlias`; the object arm is the spec's schema by reference. `ChartSchema.yAxis` is `z.array(stripImportedDefaults(SpecChartAxisSchema))`. `stripImportedDefaults` keeps the spec's two defaults out of the parse output (an injected `showGridLines: true` would read as an opt-in to the x-axis vertical grid). A refused `xAxis` object reports the object arm's own issues with their paths (so the spec's alias hint reaches the author) instead of zod's bare `Invalid input`; the issue stays `invalid_union` at `xAxis`. A non-list `yAxis` gets a remedy message.
- `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` — the TS twin: `xAxis?: string | ChartAxis`, `yAxis?: ChartAxis[]`, with the spec's `ChartAxis` type (not a restatement).
- Ledgers: `ChartAxisSchema` joins `IMPORTED` in `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts` (the accept-set differential and the node walk now cover this crossing); `data-display.zod.ts#ChartSchema` joins `SPEC_DERIVED_PAIRS` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`.
- Docs: an "Axis options" section in the plugin-charts guide (type-checked example) and two rows in the schema reference.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/types` **minor** — documents that validated before now refuse, each named in the changeset.

## 5. Pins

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/chart-axis-config-7690.test.ts` — both keys in the mirror's own shape; every spec axis key (read off the installed spec) accepted on `xAxis` and on a `yAxis` entry with the value unchanged; omitted keys stay omitted (CONTROL: the raw spec schema injects its defaults); refusals by `code` + `path`, the message compared against the SPEC's own message for the same axis (no string written in the test); `yAxis` refuses a single object and a bare name (CONTROL: the one-entry list parses); the fold unchanged; the TS twin refuses the same shapes via `@ts-expect-error` under `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`.
- `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.specAxisKeys-7690.test.ts` — declared = read, both directions: every spec axis key reaches the normalized axis, and the normalized axis carries no key the spec does not declare.

## 6. Ablation and reverse verification — committed first, proven on disk, restored by blob

The tests import the mirror from source (`../zod/data-display.zod`), so no `dist/` sits in the path. Both runs used `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, blob must move, restore proven by blob).

- **Mutation 1** — delete the two new members from `ChartSchema`. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `2d1974dffad7` → `c45e7086cc02`, on-disk count of the declaration 0. Predicted before the run: 14 failed / 10 passed in the new file, `chart-data-model-7113.test.ts` all green. Observed: **14 failed | 36 passed (50)** — the 14 are exactly the shape pin and every refusal; the 26 tests of the 7113 file and the 10 accept/control cases stay green. Restored: blob `2d1974dffad7` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Mutation 2 (TS twin)** — delete `yAxis?: SpecChartAxis[];`. Predicted: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` red on the two `yAxis` `@ts-expect-error` lines and on the parity ratchet. Observed: exit 2 with `TS2578` ×2 in the new test and `TS2322` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` naming `data-display.zod.ts#ChartSchema` and `yAxis`. Restored: blob `3fb83f914242` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## 7. Gates — at `235d4c788`

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/plugin-charts/ packages/plugin-dashboard/ examples/schema-catalog/test/` from the repo root: **465 files / 9438 tests passed**.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (tsc, examples, tests) and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` after building its closure: 0 errors each; `--listFilesOnly` confirms both test projects include the new files.
- `check:doc-snippets` (after the scoped build it names): 674 of 674 blocks judged, 0 failed. `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`: green.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`: green. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: green (1 changeset for 6 source files in 2 released packages — the second is a test file). `check:changeset-claims`: green; it lists pending changesets naming files this diff touches — the chart ones (6896, 7352) were read and none is falsified.
- ESLint over the six touched source files, per rule, base vs head: identical (`data-display.ts` `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` 30 → 30, all others 0 → 0; the two new files 0). Type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js`, so this diff cannot move any other file's verdict.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the diff: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- **Reported for the seat, not fixed here (outside the claim's declare-branch file surface):** the normalizer drops the x-axis numeric keys unless the object also carries `title`, `format` or `showGridLines`. Probe: `normalizeChartSchema({ type: 'chart', chartType: 'scatter', xAxis: { field: 'progress', min: 0, max: 200, stepSize: 50, logarithmic: true, position: 'top' } })` returns `{ chartType: 'scatter', xAxisKey: 'progress' }` — no `xAxis`; adding `title: 'P'` makes `min`/`max` survive. The guide states the current behaviour rather than teaching the dropped combination.
- The spec admits `stepSize` 0 or negative; the renderer ignores it silently. An observation only.
- `ObjectChartSchema` (`object-chart`) carries the same undeclared `xAxis` / `yAxis` passthrough, and the showcase writes `yAxis` there. Out of this card's scope; no carrier named.
- Pre-existing cross-file line citations in both edited files were not re-addressed (none added; the gate reports 0 new).
- The two-arm `xAxis` union reports `invalid_union` at `xAxis`; the object arm's issues are carried in the message, not as separate issues at `xAxis.KEY` paths.

Liveness reads and ablations are one-time proofs; nothing in this PR re-derives them except the pins above.
